description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nabodawewa, Thalawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad Map No. 110155 (7760)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically correcting parcel numbers and land extents (hectare measurements) for multiple land parcels across different districts. It involves detailed land registration matters including cadastral map references, parcel numbers, and land extent corrections, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
